//ForwardProxies: Trust X-Forwarded-* from these proxies (KnownProxies: addresses; KnownNetworks: CIDRs, e.g. the OpenShift pod network the router pods live in).
//AllowOrigins: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call this API: the webclient's own addresses. Unset means no cross-origin calls; * is refused. appsettings.Development.json allows the local webclient; deployed, the manifests set it per environment.

Strapi.//BaseUrl: Content engine base URL. Set per environment; appsettings.Development.json points at http://localhost:1337.
Strapi.//AdminApiToken: Write-scoped Strapi API token granting find + findOne + create + update on form-spec (the admin form editor) and on eligibility-rate (the admin rates editor), and nothing else - never delete. Publishing with status=published needs no separate permission. The only Strapi token this API holds; the citizen API (MyssApi) keeps the read-only one. NEVER commit a real value - set it in appsettings.local.json for local dev, or as the env var Myss_Strapi__AdminApiToken in a container. Unset means admin writes fail loudly with a 403 rather than silently succeeding, and the rates editor reads the compiled table.

//ConnectionStrings: The MySS database, shared with MyssApi: FormsDb (forms schema: stored submissions), with optional PlatformDb (the event log) and IntakeDb (applications) that fall back to FormsDb, the same keys MyssApi reads. This API reads and appends; it never migrates - MyssApi's --migrate Job owns the schema. Env vars: ConnectionStrings__FormsDb etc. appsettings.Development.json points at the compose Postgres.
//Cdogs: PDF rendering service for the bus pass PDF. Keep secrets out of source control; set ClientId/ClientSecret via local overrides or environment variables.

Oidc.//Audience: Expected 'aud'. Omit to default to ClientId - verified 2026-07-27 that a real IDIR token from this client carries aud == azp == the client id. Set to "" only for a realm that mints aud:'account', which disables audience validation and leaves the azp check as the sole guard.
Oidc.//RoleSource: Realm | Client | Both. Both is the safe default until IDIM confirms whether this realm carries roles in realm_access or resource_access.
Oidc.//DeriveClientRoleFromIdp: Same switch as MyssApi's (RoleCalculator, ADR-0007): true (default when unset) grants CLIENT to citizen-IDP sign-ins. Here it matters for its other half: a citizen-IDP token never keeps WORKER or ADMIN, whatever it carries.
Oidc.//BcServicesCardIdp: The identity_provider value a BC Services Card sign-in carries; unset defaults to ClientId, as in MyssApi.

Info.Title: My Self Serve - Admin
Info.Description: The My Self Serve staff API: form specs and eligibility rates (any IDIR user), and application review, stored submissions and the bus pass PDF (WORKER or ADMIN with IDIR).
